scope: Liens, court filings and title facts that mark a distressed NC/SC property or verify a claim about one
method: Repo docs and scrapers grepped first (1,493 domains already referenced); new candidates from web search, ArcGIS Online item search and direct polite probes (one GET per page, >= 1.7 s between requests to a host, ordinary browser User-Agent). No CAPTCHA, login, paywall or bot check was solved or routed around.
